gravity.description: automatic positioning of the element in the container. (Does not work in automatic containers like panel). Values: *top-left, top-center, top-right, center-left, center-center, center-right, bottom-left, bottom-center, bottom-right*.

cursor.description: the cursor displayed when hovering over the element (arrow/text/pointer/crosshair/ew-resize/ns-resize/...).

onclick.description: lua function called when an element is clicked.

onrightclick.description: lua function called when the right mouse button is pressed on an element.

onmiddleclick.description: lua function called when the middle mouse button is pressed on an element.

onfocus.description: lua function called when focusing on an element.

ondefocus.description: lua function called when the element loses focus.

ondoubleclick.description: lua function called when you double click on an element.

onmouseover.description: lua function called when the cursor hovers over an element.

onmouseout.description: lua function called when the cursor exits an element. onmouseenter and onmouseleave do not respect the elements hierarchy.

onmouseenter.description: lua function called when the cursor enters an element.

onmouseleave.description: lua function called when the cursor leaves an element.

max-length.description: maximal length of panel stretching before scrolling (if scrollable = true). Type: number.

min-length.description: minimal length of panel. Type: number.

if.description: with values ('', 'false', 'nil') the element will be ignored, including sub-elements.

ifnot.description: is the same as `if`, but with the opposite condition.

margin.description: element margin. Type: 4D vector *left, top, right, bottom*

z-index.description: determines the order of elements, with a larger value it will overlap elements with a smaller one.

interactive.description: if false, hovering over the element and all sub-elements will be ignored.
